hardGateAdequacy.name: COMMERCIAL_PROVIDER_REQUEST_MINIMIZATION
hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: The executable provider request is allowlisted and never permits raw learner-attempt disclosure.

hardGateAdequacy.name: PROVIDER_POLICY_BEFORE_ROUTING

testNames: provider-policy must be evaluated per provider and revision

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Only providers with an eligible decision for the required policy revision enter the routing catalog.

hardGateAdequacy.name: IMMUTABLE_PROVIDER_MODEL_ROUTE_IDENTITY

testNames: selects a bounded provider-independent immutable attempt

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Every planned physical attempt pins immutable provider, model revision, configuration, capability, and policy evidence identity.

hardGateAdequacy.name: INTEGER_MICROS_ATTEMPT_BUDGET

testNames: a physical attempt cannot overrun its reserve using unused failover reserve

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Canonical decimal-string IntegerMicros are settled per physical attempt, and no attempt may exceed its own immutable reserve.

hardGateAdequacy.name: END_TO_END_DEADLINE_BOUNDED_FAILOVER

testNames: measured execution over attempt timeout rejects low reported latency

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Trusted measured attempt and operation deadlines reject late success and permit failover only inside the remaining bounded window.

hardGateAdequacy.name: UNTRUSTED_MODEL_OUTPUT_BOUNDARY

testNames: unknown and authority-bearing provider fields are rejected

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Provider output is parsed through a recursively closed bounded response contract before any advisory is constructed.

hardGateAdequacy.name: GROUNDED_CONTEXT_OR_REFUSAL

testNames: unsupported grounded claim forces refusal/static fallback

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Unsupported provider claims cannot become instructional advice and instead produce reviewed static fallback.

hardGateAdequacy.name: CURRICULUM_TUTOR_ADMISSION

testNames: foreign trusted invocation curriculum digest fails before provider execution

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: The full trusted curriculum authority tuple, including digest and reconciled subject, must match before provider execution.

hardGateAdequacy.name: APPROVED_LEARNER_STAGE_CATALOG

testNames: unknown learner stage fails closed before provider execution

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Unknown learner-stage bindings fail closed rather than defaulting to an approved routing profile.

hardGateAdequacy.name: RECOVERABLE_EFFECT_MEMORY_REPLAY

testNames: memory failure after effect acceptance remains memory-pending and retry repairs it

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Accepted Study effects are recovered by canonical identity and memory replay remains idempotent after partial failure.

hardGateAdequacy.name: TRANSIENT_MULTIMODAL_MINIMIZATION

testNames: minimization projection cannot carry raw media, transcript, caption, or content

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Raw media, transcripts, captions, and content remain transient and cannot enter durable multimodal evidence.

hardGateAdequacy.name: PARENT_REPORT_GUARDIAN_AUTHORIZATION

testNames: wrong guardian, household, learner, session, or period authorization fails closed

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Parent reporting requires exact guardian, household, learner, session, and reporting-period authorization scope.

hardGateAdequacy.name: TELEMETRY_OPERATION_ATTEMPT_LINEAGE

testNames: projects exact commercial attempt and reservation lineage

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Commercial telemetry preserves distinct logical-operation, physical-attempt, route-plan, and reservation lineage.

hardGateAdequacy.name: CLOSED_PRESENTATION_INTENT

testNames: authority fields are rejected from intent and commercial wrapper

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Presentation proposals must match the closed trusted intent contract and cannot carry authority fields.

hardGateAdequacy.name: COMPOSED_EVALUATION_EXECUTION

testNames: unreached hard gates remain not-evaluated instead of defaulting to pass

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Only executed composed-system checks may pass; unreached hard gates remain explicitly not evaluated.

hardGateAdequacy.name: CROSS_CHILD_COMMERCIAL_ISOLATION

testNames: foreign learner scope cannot influence the invocation

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: The trusted learner scope must exactly match the commercial invocation before any provider call.

hardGateAdequacy.name: ONE_STUDY_ENGINE_AUTHORITY

testNames: canonical commercial flow returns only a Study advisory

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Tutor output remains advisory and cannot mutate Study mastery, working level, curriculum, or segment completion.

hardGateAdequacy.name: NO_VENDOR_PRODUCTION_IMPORT

testNames: Wave 3 foundation has no vendor, deployment, credential, or production UI imports

hardGateAdequacy.sourceInvariant: Wave 3 foundation source contains no vendor SDK, deployment, credential, hosted-service, or production UI import.
